mermaid-layout-elk/ — vendored @mermaid-js/layout-elk ES module build
=====================================================================

Package
    @mermaid-js/layout-elk@0.2.3  (last release with peerDependency
    mermaid ^11; 1.x requires mermaid 12)

Entry and export
    mermaid-layout-elk/mermaid-layout-elk.js, an ES module whose default
    export is the layout loader array passed to
    window.mermaid.registerLayoutLoaders. utils/mermaidElk.ts imports it at
    runtime by URL; the Bun build never sees it.

Bundler
    esbuild 0.28.1 (pinned via `npx esbuild@0.28.1`), ESM with code
    splitting, so a page fetches only the chunks the ELK renderer needs.

Exact command
    mkdir /tmp/elk-vendor && cd /tmp/elk-vendor
    npm init -y
    npm install @mermaid-js/layout-elk@0.2.3
    echo "export { default } from '@mermaid-js/layout-elk';" > entry-esm.js
    npx --yes esbuild@0.28.1 entry-esm.js --bundle --format=esm \
        --splitting --minify --outdir=split \
        --entry-names=mermaid-layout-elk '--chunk-names=chunk-[hash]'
    cp split/*.js <frontend>/public/vendor/mermaid-layout-elk/

Output
    106 files, ~5.0 MiB total on disk. The package ships its own copy of
    mermaid 11.17.0's internals with every diagram type's lazy chunk, which
    is where the size comes from; a page fetches about 1.5 MiB of it.

Resolved dependency pins
    @mermaid-js/layout-elk@0.2.3
    elkjs@0.9.3
    d3@7.9.0

Landmine
    The bundled mermaid copy registers its own window "load" listener with
    startOnLoad true. Evaluated before that event fires, it re-runs every
    `.mermaid` element from its rendered SVG text and replaces the diagram
    with a syntax error. utils/mermaidElk.ts imports this module only after
    document.readyState is "complete".

Version coupling
    Upgrade together with mermaid.min.js (see mermaid.provenance.txt).
